subject: Horizon AI — post-term usage finalization & one-time charge
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@horizon.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Billing <billing@horizon.ai>
Date: 2027-02-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Usage wrap-up after Q4 expansion

Hi Mateo,

We wrapped up our capacity expansion in late January and I’m reconciling the invoices for Q4/Q1. Finance flagged a ~1.9M token delta for January (post-invoice) that wasn’t included in the committed-capacity true-up you and I discussed on the call.

Attached is our export from internal usage and the billing system shows the original invoice plus an additional usage line dated 2027-02-01. Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a one-time invoice for the delta or roll it into March billing as an adjustment? We need to finalize by 3/5 to close our books.

Thanks —
Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of Cloud Ops, Horizon AI
Samantha.li@horizon.ai
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: Horizon_REPORT_jan_export.csv (csv), notes.txt (text)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@horizon.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Horizon Billing <billing@horizon.ai>
Date: 2027-02-25T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Usage wrap-up after Q4 expansion

Hi Samantha — thanks for the export and the heads-up. I pulled the usage summary on our side and see the same delta in the raw token logs after the capacity increase: there were a handful of burst windows where the committed pool usage exceeded the contracted threshold, and our system recorded them as billable overage.

Proposal: we can issue a one-time invoice for the delta (breakdown attached) and offer a 20% goodwill credit on the billable overage given this was the first month after expansion and we missed a short callout on burst protection. That brings the net one-time charge to $7,800 (net of credits). If Horizon prefers, we can instead apply the net amount as an adjustment on the March invoice to simplify remittance.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm preferred path (separate invoice vs March adjustment)
- If separate invoice, share PO or billing contact for remittance
- If adjust to March, confirm we have approval to proceed and we will reflect it on your 3/1 invoice.

Attaching: Horizon_FINAL_usage_summary.csv (generated by Redwood invoice pipeline)

I’m looping Jordan (rev ops) and Laura (account lead) to expedite.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-26T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Horizon overage reconciliation — PO and invoice path

Team — quick internal note so we’re aligned before I respond to Samantha:

Summary:
- Raw delta: ~1.9M tokens (Jan 16-28 burst windows)
- Gross overage amount: $9,750 (before goodwill credit)
- Proposed goodwill credit (Mateo): 20% -> net $7,800

Considerations:
- If Horizon wants a separate invoice, revenue ops will need a PO number and the DocuSign if they require signed acceptance of the one-time charge.
- If we roll into March invoice, we should add a line item titled "Post-term usage adjustment (Jan burst windows)" and include the CSV summary and a note about credit applied. This keeps collections on the same cadence but may delay their close.

Recommendation: offer the separate invoice with the 20% credit and 30-day payment terms. It keeps transparency and doesn’t affect their March amortization. Laura, can you confirm commercial approval for the credit?

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@horizon.ai>, Horizon Billing <billing@horizon.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Usage wrap-up after Q4 expansion

Samantha — thanks for the patience. Commercial has approved the 20% goodwill credit and we will issue a separate one-time invoice for the net overage of $7,800.

Action items:
1) Horizon: please confirm PO number or billing contact to send the invoice to (billing@horizon.ai is fine if you want the PDF).
2) Redwood: Jordan, please generate the invoice and include the attached CSV as supporting detail. Add the line: "Post-term usage adjustment (Jan 16–28 burst windows); goodwill credit applied". Use DEAL-3891 in the invoice reference.
3) Mateo: I’ll draft the short note for the DocuSign if they ask for a sign-off.

Samantha — if you confirm PO, we’ll route the invoice today so your team can close by 3/5.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Director, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: Horizon_FINAL_usage_summary.csv (supporting), Horizon_one_time_invoice.pdf (will be generated after PO)
